title: Marrow Studio
description:
Marrow Studio is a minimalist marketing website for an independent Indian branding and web design agency, built as a synthesis of editorial design
  sensibility and modern web engineering. The visual language centers on a "warm mineral" palette—Bone White backgrounds, Charcoal Slate text, and a
  restrained Terracotta Vermilion accent occupying under 10% of visual weight—paired with a deliberate typographic hierarchy: Instrument Serif for editorial
  headlines, DM Sans for clean body copy, and JetBrains Mono for precise meta-labels. Architected on Next.js 14 with TypeScript and Tailwind CSS, the App
  Router powers a mobile-first, fully responsive experience featuring dynamic project case studies, a work gallery, and a validated contact form backed by
  an API route. Every page includes comprehensive SEO metadata, Open Graph tags, and JSON-LD structured data, while next/image ensures optimized media
  delivery. The codebase targets 90+ scores across all Lighthouse categories—Performance, Accessibility, Best Practices, and SEO—reflecting a commitment to
  technical rigor matching the studio's design standards. The result is a performant, accessible, and visually cohesive digital storefront that communicates
  the agency's expertise through both its content and its craft.
